column1: # Seconds per suite on GitHub's 2-core Linux machine, read from the suite tables in the parts' logs: the median of the
# PASS rows of the 8 newest green merge-queue batch runs with 8 parts (14 Nov, nightly fix: 43529755382, 43513878221,
# Suites none of those batches ran (quarantined then, by hand or by B122) take the median of the finished parts 2 and 4
# of scheduled nightly run 43343263212 (13 Nov; check_bk5_start_browser.cjs, check_c95_release_update_browser.ts), else
# keep the 10 Nov file's value (14 suites; that file: median of 8 batches with 6 parts, 42832155459 ... 42751977941).
# run-suites.sh --shard balances the shards by these times (longest first); a suite missing here counts as 30 s.
# Refresh the same way when many suites are new (the 10 Nov file summed 213 min against 311 min measured on 14 Nov and
# lacked 72 of 481 units, which left the longest batch part ~25 min behind the shortest and the nightly beyond 45 min).
